# Crawl4AI 0.9.4 Original Source Provenance

`crawl4ai-0.9.4.tar.gz` is the unchanged source distribution published on PyPI.
Its URL and independently checked upstream SHA-256 are retained in the build
recipe and digest sidecar. The original complete LICENSE, including its appended
attribution requirement, remains inside the archive and every built wheel.

SuperZip's development installer builds `0.9.4+superzip.portable2` through
`tools/crawl4ai_source_build.py`. The source repair, added Apache-2.0 helper,
modified-source notice, wheel digest and normal locked installation are documented
in `docs/crawl4ai-portable-download-repair-2026-10-05.md`. No source archive,
installed package, browser or personal cache is modified in place.
